reason: CAS 900-95-8 (triphenyltin acetate) is structurally an organotin with acetate ester; however, the catalog scope is Trialkyl tin / Tributyl tin compounds and triphenyltin is triaryl not trialkyl. Reconsidering, triphenyltin acetate does not match the enumerated tributyltin/trialkyltin hydroxide members, which are all butyl-tin species, so no exact match exists.
